# Historical Unverified Pilot Data (Pre-`kitaev-numerics` Split)

These `.dat` files were generated during 2026-11-07 prototype sessions prior to spinning out `kitaev-numerics`.
They are **not** certified external oracle benchmarks (`W001-REVIEW-01` / `FND-ORACLE`) and must never be cited as verified ED or 2-RDM SDP evidence.
They remain here for audit provenance until superseded by pinned exports in `data/external/kitaev_numerics/`.
